S3P - Security in 3Play services

Scope

National

Research Group

Networks, Communications and Security

coordinator

Paulo Simões

Researchers

Edmundo Monteiro

Tiago Cruz

Synopsis

The objective of this project is to identify new security risks - introduced by the growing number of domestic networks (SOHO) with broadband connection to the Internet - and to define new technical and commercial approaches able to neutralize these risk

Funding

PT Inovação

Total budget

€ 25 000.00

Start Date

2008-03-01

Partners

CISUC, PT Inovação

End Date

2009-02-28

Publications

2009
